newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait Ahmadi refinery maintenance in March-April.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait Ahmadi refinery maintenance in March-April.

text.p: Kuwait will perform major maintenance work at its 420,000 barrels per day (bpd) Mina al-Ahmadi refinery in March and April 1997, an industry source said on Monday.
A current two-week maintenance on "one of the smaller CDUs (crude distillation units)" at Ahmadi will be completed by Friday, the source said without giving further details.
Gulf oil traders had earlier said a 170,000 bpd unit, one of three at Kuwait's largest refinery, was due to close for a three-week maintenance starting November 3.

An industry executive said most of Kuwait's contracts for refined products were long-term and maintenance work is usually well-planned to avoid "harming the customer or creating a problem of supply for him".

The industry source said major maintenance work at Ahmadi "is planned between March and April next year. This year there is routine preventive maintenance...Now there is boiler and evaporator maintenance and a sulphur unit maintenance."
Mina al-Ahmadi, which operates under state refiner Kuwait National Petroleum Co, is a major exporter of middle distillates such as gas oil (diesel) and kerosene to Asia and the Indian subcontinent.
Kuwait, which has an OPEC quota of two million bpd, has a local refining capacity of 830,000 bpd which it plans to raise to 1.0 million bpd.
